_doc: Living Knox (LK02-T05): source table of the animation nodes added to the zombie AnimSets for npc bodies.
Every node requires actorVariable = true (BOOL): a zombie without this variable never passes it
(AnimCondition.java: a missing BOOL variable equals false). conditionPriority puts the nodes before every vanilla node
of priority 0 in these states (AnimNode.compareSelectionConditions: priority, then condition count).
clip: Bob_ clip already played by the vanilla player node named in proof; media/anims_X/Bob/<clip>.x must exist.
Conditions: [name, type, value]; stateConditions adds conditions in one state only (pathfind: bMoving).
events (LK04-T11): [name, time, value], name SetVariable or PlaySound, time Start, End or a fraction of the clip.
progress: [Started, Finished] variables of a climb state; each node of the state must set the next one
Climb nodes: human clips of the player nodes, no OnFloor (no fall on landing, no fence damage); the outcomes fall,
falling, obstacle and lunge stay with the vanilla zombie nodes.
Window gestures (LK04-T13): openwindow and closewindow play the two clips of the player node in turn; the first
node sets phaseVariable at its End (LK_Anim clears it at every gesture change). Same clips, speeds and PlaySound
as the player nodes (AnimSets/player/openwindow, closewindow); the window itself is toggled by the authority
(LK_Obstacles) at the time of the vanilla WindowOpenSuccess / WindowCloseSuccess event. No door gesture: the
vanilla player opens a door without any animation (ISOpenCloseDoor, duration 0).

nodes.name: LKActorIdle
nodes.covers: idle, walk and run while standing; any unknown gesture

nodes.name: LKActorCrouchIdle
nodes.covers: crouch while standing

nodes.name: LKActorAimHandgun
nodes.covers: aim with a handgun or no weapon

nodes.name: LKActorAimRifle
nodes.covers: aim with a long gun (Weapon = firearm, set by setPrimaryHandItem)

nodes.name: LKActorGuard2H
nodes.covers: melee guard, two-handed or no weapon

nodes.name: LKActorGuard1H
nodes.covers: melee guard with a one-handed weapon

nodes.name: LKActorStrike2H
nodes.covers: melee strike, two-handed or no weapon; repeated while the gesture stays strike

nodes.name: LKActorStrike1H
nodes.covers: melee strike with a one-handed weapon

nodes.name: LKActorStrikeFloor2H
nodes.covers: melee strike at a zombie on the floor (LK06-T09), two-handed or any weapon but one-handed; 1.0 s clip at 0.80 like strike

nodes.name: LKActorStrikeFloor1H
nodes.covers: melee strike at a zombie on the floor with a one-handed weapon (LK06-T09)

nodes.name: LKActorStomp
nodes.covers: bare-handed stomp on a zombie on the floor (LK06-T09); 1.233 s clip at 0.99: one stomp per 1.25 s

nodes.name: LKActorShootHandgun
nodes.covers: firearm shot (LK06-T03), handgun or no weapon; one shot per loop (0.667 s clip: 1.0 s per shot)

nodes.name: LKActorShootRifle
nodes.covers: firearm shot with a long gun (Weapon = firearm); one shot per loop (0.5 s clip: 1.0 s per shot)

nodes.name: LKActorReloadHandgun
nodes.covers: firearm reload (LK06-T03), handgun or no weapon; 1.5 s clip at the vanilla base reload speed 0.80

nodes.name: LKActorReloadRifle
nodes.covers: firearm reload with a long gun (Weapon = firearm); 1.733 s clip at 0.80

nodes.name: LKActorSit
nodes.covers: sitting on the floor (rest and sleep of the routines, LK05-T03)

nodes.name: LKActorKneel
nodes.covers: kneeling, hands forward: tending a fire or a stove, caring for a wounded member (chores, LK05-T04)

nodes.name: LKActorSurrender
nodes.covers: standing, both hands raised: surrender (LK06-T12), vanilla surrender emote, whole body (speed of surrender.xml)

nodes.name: LKActorRummage
nodes.covers: rummaging at waist height: tidying a piece of furniture, no container opened (chores, LK05-T04)

nodes.name: LKActorHammer
nodes.covers: hammering standing, no sound, no tool: repairing a door or a window frame (chores, LK05-T04)

nodes.name: LKActorSmoke
nodes.covers: smoking standing, no cigarette item, no sound (smoker trait, chores, LK05-T04)

nodes.name: LKActorWarmHands
nodes.covers: sitting on the floor, hands towards a fire or a stove (chores, LK05-T04)

nodes.name: LKActorOpenWindowStart
nodes.covers: opening a closed window, hands to the sash (LK04-T13); 0.42 s at this speed

nodes.name: LKActorOpenWindow
nodes.covers: opening a closed window, pushing it up (LK04-T13); 1.33 s, the authority opens it at 45 %

nodes.name: LKActorCloseWindowStart
nodes.covers: closing an open window behind the body, hands to the sash (LK04-T13); 0.54 s at this speed

nodes.name: LKActorCloseWindow
nodes.covers: closing an open window, pulling it down (LK04-T13); 1.54 s, the authority closes it at 35 %

nodes.name: LKActorWalk
nodes.covers: moving with any gesture but run and crouch

nodes.name: LKActorRun
nodes.covers: moving with the run gesture

nodes.name: LKActorCrouchWalk
nodes.covers: moving with the crouch gesture

nodes.name: LKActorPathWaitIdle
nodes.covers: pathfind state while waiting for a path (vanilla pathfindWait)

nodes.name: LKActorPathWaitCrouch
nodes.covers: pathfind state while waiting, crouch gesture

nodes.name: LKActorClimbWindowStart
nodes.covers: window climb, first half (any outcome): the Java slides the body to the opening

nodes.name: LKActorClimbWindowEnd
nodes.covers: window climb, landing on its feet (outcome success); the Java slides the body through

nodes.name: LKActorClimbFenceStart
nodes.covers: low fence vault, first half (any outcome)

nodes.name: LKActorClimbFenceEnd
nodes.covers: low fence vault, landing on its feet (outcome success); the Java slides the body over
